not_installed: The iPhone helper isn't on this computer yet
install_detail: Downloads it from Persona's release and checks its size and hashes before installing; whatever is there stays until then.
install_failed_download: Couldn't download the iPhone helper. Check this computer's connection, then try again.
install_failed_check: The downloaded iPhone helper didn't check out, so nothing was installed. Try again.
offline: The computer is offline. iPhones can be operated through it once it's back
not_mac: This computer can't operate iPhones yet
not_mac_detail: The Apple developer files an iPhone needs come with Xcode on a Mac, so Linux computers can't do this yet.
no_xcode: Install Xcode from the App Store on this Mac first
no_xcode_detail: Getting an iPhone ready uses the Apple developer files Xcode brings; once it's installed, click Check again.
none: No iPhone is paired with this computer yet
none_detail: Connect the iPhone to this computer with a cable and unlock it; it shows up here.
on_cable: On the cable, not paired yet
pair_trust: On this iPhone, tap Trust, then enter its passcode
pair_unlock: Unlock this iPhone so pairing can go on
pair_timeout: Nobody tapped Trust on the iPhone in time. Click Pair to try again.
developer_mode_off: Developer Mode is off: turn it on in Settings › Privacy & Security › Developer Mode on the iPhone; it restarts once
prepare_detail: The computer puts a small developer component from Apple on this iPhone. Nothing is reinstalled or erased. It goes away when the iPhone restarts, and the computer adds it again by itself.
prepare_more: Apple's developer disk image. Each time, Apple's signing server makes it for this iPhone, so Apple receives this iPhone's chip ID.
preparing: Getting this iPhone ready, about a minute
needs_xcode: Not ready yet: this Mac needs Xcode first
prepare_failed_ddi: This Mac needs Xcode first: install it from the App Store, then try again.
prepare_failed_tss: Apple's signing server didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
locked: Locked: unlock it to let the assistant operate it
waiting_consent: Waiting for this iPhone to allow it
consent_hint: An iPhone is operated only after it allows it: in Persona on that iPhone, open Settings › Connectors › This iPhone.
ready_wifi: The assistant can operate it · connected over Wi‑Fi
ready_cable: The assistant can operate it · connected with a cable
